rationale: Association vendor showroom directory: mine once to enumerate the self-service vendor universe, not a continuous signal stream.
Per-vendor Finextra archive is a section of finextra.com; monitoring the parent trade-press feed covers it.
Single article on an OpenWay WAY4 selection: corroborating evidence, not a recurring source.
Primary vendor site for SmartVista/BPC UA deployments; flag RU-domiciled spin-off domains as compliance-sensitive.
Wayback is a durable retrieval utility for vendor case studies delisted after 2022; keep as standing tool.
NBU newsroom is an authoritative, continuously publishing regulator hub naming payment infrastructure and technology operators.
Leading UA payments/self-service integrator with public vendor-partner and bank-client walls: core competitor source.
Multi-vendor field-service competitor naming 40+ serviced brands and bank/retail clients; direct maintenance-contract intelligence.
Distributor/integrator with published UA self-service project references and NCR/Diebold partnerships.
Pure-play ATM maintenance competitor evidencing installed GRG/NCR/Wincor fleets in Ukraine.
Cash-equipment distributor and authorised service centre with nationwide partner network; maps the cash-handling sub-segment.
Exclusive single-brand UA distributor; useful for brand-to-distributor exclusivity mapping in cash equipment.
Bank cash-centre equipment distributor (Kisan, Ribao); adds another brand-to-distributor link and a competitor.
Reseller banking-equipment catalogue: thin but shows which foreign brands are certified and stocked for UA banks.
Low-credibility safe reseller at the edge of scope and currently unreachable; re-check liveness before spending review time.
Major private security operator with a dedicated bank/ATM protection line; adjacent servicing layer around the ATM estate.
Non-bank CIT operator serving banks; track both cit.net.ua and cit-security.ua as one entity.
Additional commercial CIT/security provider broadening the cash-logistics competitor map.
Quantified outsourced-ATM-servicing disclosures, but a service page under the already-monitored Oschadbank domain.
High-value one-off KB article naming the bank's POS service organisation, but URL unreachable; re-verify then harvest.
IT integrator/outsourcer with documented large bank contracts; note debarment history when assessing as partner.
Large national integrator with financial-sector work; URL check failed, so re-verify liveness before approving.
Major UA integrator competing for bank IT infrastructure; site publishes partnerships and references.
Integrator blog acting as a soft case-study stream naming banks it has integrated with.
Domestic self-service kiosk manufacturer: evidence of locally built terminals competing with foreign vendors.
Marketplace product listing for a small domestic terminal maker; weak, unreachable, largely redundant with c_249.
Single group-site page on the UA entity's results; covered by monitoring printecgroup.com — beware the colliding printec.ua names.
Prozorro tender search with open API: hardest evidence of who holds UA ATM/POS supply and maintenance contracts.
